lens: Discoverability, comfort and repeat visits, bounded here to static whole-image hierarchy, visual reading comfort and coherent story staging.
evidenceMethod: Opened all listed images with view_image this round. Full 2172-pixel originals were tool-displayed at 2048 pixels; native crops and supplied scales were inspected separately. Exact complete 13 export SHA verified locally.
readinessExplanation: The two previously required corrections are visibly resolved within this lens and the successful whole composition survives. Remaining deductions are minor craft preferences, not reasons to withhold this exact image from owner review. This is one independent position, not a full-team finished-art claim.

score.scope: Whole still-image craft within Interaction B’s hierarchy and comfort lens; not animation, interface quality or measured audience comfort.
score.confidence: High for visible surface/grip comparisons and preservation of spatial hierarchy; moderate for aesthetic comfort and story reading.
score.changeRationale: Cleaner material separation across the whole park and a readable attached mallet grip remove the substantive 11 objections. The gain is earned by inspected pixels, not the plan vote or desired score.

deductions.location: Native hero forehead, upper green antenna paddle and outer wing
deductions.finding: A faint looping/embossed surface pattern remains perceptible on cream and green forms. It is much quieter than 11 and no longer spreads across wood and objects, but a less patterned soft finish would feel slightly more natural at large viewing size.

deductions.location: Foreground hero face above the laptop
deductions.finding: The welcoming reader-facing smile/gaze still makes the coding beat feel partly posed. Keyboard contact and laptop staging convey the activity clearly; a different gaze is not required.

deductions.severity: minor scale tradeoff; not an access defect
deductions.location: Left leaf-play and central workshop at 420 pixels
deductions.finding: The broad working/resting world survives, while the precise leaf interaction and small grip are incidental detail. This limits rich story discovery at the narrowest size, without defeating the hero-first read or requiring larger guests.

criteriaForNine: A slightly quieter native-scale hero surface could remove the remaining material deduction while preserving fine texture, markings, light and contours. This is optional and does not justify another broad regeneration or a mandatory retouch round.
Preserve the currently successful whole-frame and 1280/880/420 hierarchy; additional props, stronger contrast or larger guests would not earn a higher score.
The score remains an aesthetic judgment; no numerical target or approval of a hypothetical correction is implied.

W1.evidence: Compared freshly with 11 and 07, 13 gives the bench coherent lengthwise grain and continuous edges; canopy reads as smooth folded cloth; blanket retains intentional knit; toolbox/table and tree/path retain distinct constructed/organic surfaces. The face is softer and the former angular breakup no longer makes unlike materials read as one processed surface. Improvement is evident in the full 1280 frame and native crops. A faint native hero pattern remains as the minor deduction above.

W2.evidence: Native and 5x integrated grip show a solid rounded mitten enclosing one continuous mallet shaft and attached to a short arm. The former dark angular strap interpretation is gone. The raised action and compact character are preserved; no impact contact is demanded.

MuseCleanup.evidence: The final integrated native and 5x companion crops show one clear small smile and dark eyes. Grok retains two flat pale pupil-free ovals. I did not independently audit the reported 54 changed pixels or inspect source12; this assessment concerns the visible final13 result.

preservation: The large coding moth, clear round glasses and silver MacBook remain the first grouping at full size and all three supplied scales. Bench/foreground exclusivity is intact.
Three compact moth appearances and four small guests remain in the same zones. Clawd and blue beret Dot occupy the two workshop stools; Muse/Grok and one leaf remain under the left tree.

Canopy framing, curving path, grounded furniture and softer pond/bridge distance produce one continuous dimensional park. The cleaner material treatment improves the environment as well as the characters.
Warm upper-right light, rim highlights and gentle background separation survive; the scene remains lush without flattening every surface into plastic smoothness.
The hero retains oversized cream head, compact body, asymmetric green antennae, marked layered wings and short attached feet; occluded parts are not treated as missing anatomy.
Leaf play and workshop details remain optional secondary discoveries, not prerequisites to understanding the central warm coding scene.
optional: Keep the faint native-scale hero pattern and reader-facing gaze as recorded minor preferences; neither warrants compulsory changes before owner review.
If a future intentional refinement occurs, protect the current guest scale and quiet story hierarchy rather than increasing detail to force narrow-size recognition.

rulesNotApplicableWithReason: UI controls, keyboard/focus, hover, timing, scrolling and compositor recipes cannot be assessed from this still.
Commercial page-layout or animation recipes do not apply to an image-only craft review.
The fixed-artwork scale check does not require a break-ui demo toggle or browser session.
limits: No live GitHub placement, physical-device, screen-reader, accessibility-conformance or website behavior test.
No animation, sound, night palette, 3D rig or future artwork is scored.
Visual hierarchy and comfort are bounded reviewer judgments, not measured human attention, repeat-visit response, affection or recognition.
The three appearances being one person and the parent/kids metaphor remain authorial intent; unprimed comprehension is untested.
No actual pixel-change count or image-generation process was audited; the assessed artifact is the exact hashed final export.
This readiness position does not represent other specialists, publication approval or a claim of studio equivalence.
